description: This file defines the `Incrementor` class in the Apache Commons Math library, providing functionality for incrementing counters with customizable behavior upon reaching a maximum count.

classes.name: Incrementor
classes.description: A utility class that increments a counter until a maximum is reached. It throws a MaxCountExceededException or invokes a callback when the maximum is exceeded.

methods.name: Incrementor
methods.description: Constructs an Incrementor with default maximum count of 0 and a default callback that throws MaxCountExceededException.

methods.name: Incrementor
methods.description: Constructs an Incrementor with a specified maximum count and default callback behavior.

methods.name: Incrementor
methods.description: Constructs an Incrementor with specified maximum count and a user-defined callback for handling count exhaustion.

methods.name: setMaximalCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum count for the counter.

methods.name: getMaximalCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum count for the counter.

methods.name: canIncrement
methods.description: Checks if the counter can be incremented without exceeding the maximum.

methods.name: incrementCount
methods.description: Increments the count by one and triggers callback if maximum is exceeded.

methods.name: incrementCount
methods.description: Increments the count by a specified value, throwing exception if limit exceeded.
